questions.stem: Two shapes are similar if they have:

options.text: The same angles and sides in the same ratio

questions.explanation: Similar shapes have the same angles (same shape) and their corresponding sides are in the same ratio (a scale factor). They do not need to be the same size.

questions.stem: Triangle $A$ has sides $3\text{ cm}$, $4\text{ cm}$, and $5\text{ cm}$. Triangle $B$ is similar to $A$ with a scale factor of $2$. What are the sides of triangle $B$?
questions.explanation: With a scale factor of $2$, each side is multiplied by $2$: $3 \times 2 = 6$, $4 \times 2 = 8$, $5 \times 2 = 10$.
